finding.problem: A schema-valid evidence document declared git_blob_sha values that were either nonexistent or different from the blob at path on material_head_sha.

sibling_cases.procedure: Run the validator fixture with a 40-hex SHA that is not present as a Git blob.
sibling_cases.expected: Validation fails before provenance can be certified.
sibling_cases.observed: The validator rejected the nonexistent blob SHA.

sibling_cases.procedure: Run the validator fixture with a valid blob SHA belonging to a sibling path.
sibling_cases.expected: Validation fails because the declared blob is not the blob at source_proof.path on material_head_sha.
sibling_cases.observed: The validator rejected the valid-but-wrong-path blob SHA.

positive_case.procedure: Run the same validator with the exact blob returned for source_proof.path at material_head_sha.
